Building on three generations of Rogue and nearly 4 million units sold, Rogue Hybrid elevates the driving experience with advanced engineering, powerful technology and a bold new design. "The all-new Rogue Hybrid is exactly what customers have been asking for: the functionality, technology and packaging of a Rogue, now paired with an advanced hybrid powertrain that enhances efficiency while delivering a dynamic driving experience," said Ponz Pandikuthira , senior vice president, chief product and planning officer, Nissan Americas. "By listening closely to customers and designing around their needs, we've created a hybrid SUV that delivers an agile and spirited driving experience while adding the benefits of a hybrid powertrain. The instantaneous torque delivery, with a quiet and efficient powertrain, will redefine what hybrid means in this segment." The 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid reaches dealers in fall 2026, initially launching with the stylish and well-equipped all-wheel drive SR with SR Technology Package grade. The full model range (SV, SR and Platinum) is available in early 2027 with Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Prices (MSRP) starting at $35,490 5 for the SV grade. Media Nissan Vehicle Owner Dealer Associate Analyst/Investor Employee Industry Peer Other Subscribe Top Searches Rogue Hybrid Re:Nissan Murano Accolades Armada Kicks Z LEAF Plug-in Hybrid Home / A new kind of hybrid in its class: All-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid debuts in the U.S. A new kind of hybrid in its class: All-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid debuts in the U.S. Designed to elevate everyday driving, the all-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid delivers smoother control, quicker performance and quieter operation Save Remove Download Share Subscribe Photos / Galleries / Videos September 21, 2026 NASHVILLE, Tenn. – Nissan has fully revealed the most advanced and efficient version yet of its best-selling SUV for the U.S. market. The all-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid is smoother, quicker and quieter, combining new-in-class hybrid technology 1 with effortless functionality, cutting-edge style and the equipment needed to meet the requirements of today's SUV buyers. "Hybrids are increasingly becoming the powertrain of choice for U.S. customers, and we believe that trend will only accelerate," said Christian Meunier , chairman, Nissan Americas. "The launch of Rogue Hybrid marks a pivotal moment for Nissan, helping us attract new customers and strengthen our business. We are bringing the best hybrid technology to market that combines exceptional efficiency with a truly engaging driving experience. The result is smooth, responsive performance, immediate torque delivery, and one of the quietest cabins in its class." When Nissan announced its long-term vision, Mobility Intelligence for Everyday Life , in April 2026, it committed to delivering smarter, more intuitive products that enrich customers' daily lives while strengthening the company's competitiveness worldwide. Central to that plan is the United States, one of Nissan's three lead markets and a key engine of growth, profitability, and scale. The all-new 2027 Nissan Rogue Hybrid is a cornerstone of that strategy. As one of Nissan's Core vehicles in its largest market, Rogue represents a critical early proof point of this vision in action, bringing advanced hybrid innovation, intuitive customer-focused features and everyday practicality together in a vehicle designed around the needs of modern families. Featuring Nissan's proven hybrid e‑POWER technology – which uses a gasoline engine to charge a battery that powers dual electric motors – the all-new 2027 Rogue Hybrid goes on sale in fall 2026. Initially launching with the stylish and well-equipped all-wheel drive SR with SR Technology Package, the full model range (SV, SR and Platinum) is available in early 2027 with Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Prices (MSRP) starting at $35,490 2 for the SV grade.
